program.section_heading: Spanish - Associate in Arts for Transfer (ADT) - NAA708 (Cal-GETC)
outcomes: Demonstrate critical thinking skills in Spanish by interpreting and articulating ideas, questions, opinions and information at the high-intermediate level, both orally and in writing.
Analyze the practices, products and perspectives of the Spanish-speaking countries and peoples throughout the world through a comparison of Hispanic cultures and their own.

notes: The heading is printed twice, once as '(CaI-GETC)' (apparent typo) and once as '(Cal-GETC)'; the latter is used.

The 14 courses after the placement note (ANT-2 through SOC-10H, printed under an unlabeled '42.00' total) are appropriate substitutions only when a student places out of a required course without units, to reach at least 18 units in the major; they are not part of the 23-unit requirement, so they are not placed in a block. A reviewer may prefer to record them as a substitution block.
AP Spanish Literature and Culture exam score of 3, 4 or 5 can apply three units under List A.
Total 23.00 units = Required Courses 20 + List A 3.
